items.source: Due to the lack of checking there are likely some expressions that should never be compiled, for example if an expression is continuously dealing with different types of data. Due to these cases the compiler is something that must be selectively turned on for an associated SpelExpressionParser (through the SpelParserConfiguration object), it is not on by default.
items.translation: 由于缺乏检查，可能存在一些本不应被编译的表达式，例如如果某个表达式持续处理不同类型的。因此，编译器必须通过 `SpelParserConfiguration` 对象为关联的 `SpelExpressionParser` 选择性开启，默认情况下并未启用。

items.source: Individual expressions can be compiled by calling SpelCompiler.compile(expression).
items.translation: 可以通过调用SpelCompiler.compile(expression)来编译单个表达式。

items.source:
The SpelCompiler is not currently handling all expression types but covers many of
the common cases. The framework is extensible to cover more cases in the future. For
absolute maximum speed there is *no checking* in the compiled code. The compiled
version of the expression uses information learned during interpreted runs of the
expression when it generates the byte code. For example if it knows that a particular
property dereference always seems to return a Map then it will generate byte code that
expects the result of the property dereference to be a Map. This ensures maximal
performance but should the dereference result in something other than a map, the
compiled expression will fail - like a ClassCastException would occur if passing data
of an unexpected type in a regular Java program.
items.translation: SpelCompiler 目前尚不支持所有表达式类型，但已涵盖许多常见情况。该框架具有可扩展性，未来可支持更多情况。为实现绝对最高的执行速度，编译后的代码中*不进行任何检查*。表达式编译版本在生成字节码时，会利用解释式运行期间学到的信息。例如，如果它知道某个属性解引用操作似乎总是返回 Map，则会生成期望属性解引用结果为 Map 的字节码。这确保了最大性能，但如果解引用结果不是 Map，则编译后的表达式将失败——类似于在常规 Java 程序中传递意外类型数据时发生的 ClassCastException。

items.source:
Attempt compilation of the supplied expression. A check is made to see
if it is compilable before compilation proceeds. The check involves
visiting all the nodes in the expression AST and ensuring enough state
is known about them that bytecode can be generated for them.
items.translation: 尝试编译提供的表达式。在开始编译之前，会进行检查以确认其是否可编译。该检查涉及遍历表达式 AST 中的所有节点，并确保已知足够的状态信息以便为它们生成字节码。

items.source:
Factory method for compiler instances. The returned SpelCompiler will
attach a class loader as the child of the given class loader and this
child will be used to load compiled expressions.
items.translation: 工厂方法，用于创建编译器实例。返回的 SpelCompiler 将附加一个类加载器作为给定类加载器的子加载器，该子加载器将用于加载编译后的表达式。

items.source:
Request that an attempt is made to compile the specified expression.
It may fail if components of the expression are not suitable for compilation
or the data types involved are not suitable for compilation. Used for testing.
items.translation: 请求尝试编译指定的表达式。如果表达式的组件不适合编译，或涉及的数据类型不适合编译，则可能会失败。用于测试。

items.source:
Request to revert to the interpreter for expression evaluation.
Any compiled form is discarded but can be recreated by later recompiling again.
items.translation: 请求回退到解释器以进行表达式求值。任何编译形式均会被丢弃，但可以通过后续重新编译再次创建。

items.source: true if the expression was successfully compiled, false otherwise
items.translation: true 表示表达式已成功编译，否则为 false。

items.source: an instance of the class implementing the compiled expression, or null if compilation is not possible
items.translation: 实现编译后表达式的类的实例，或者如果无法编译则为null

items.source: classLoader - the ClassLoader to use as the basis for compilation
items.translation: classLoader - 用作编译基础的类加载器
